superseded_documented_files.v184_reason: v1.8.4 STRICT replay protocol: seal equality alone no longer counts as replay success; now requires verdict_match AND evidence_match AND seal_valid AND seal_match AND replay_executed together, else downgrades CONFIRMED to INCONCLUSIVE (replay_valid=false). Documented in the file's own module docstring.

Added get_policy_hash() and apply_hypothesis_weights() methods, plus _hypothesis_weights initialization. Required to enable real LLM execution path in learning experiments and contract trace. The pre-existing LLM safety boundary (system_prompt_hash, prompt_injection_resistance, generate_hypotheses/select_experiment split) remains intact and unchanged.

SSRF guard added (Phase 14 finding, referenced inline at the fix site): an absolute URL in tool-call params bypassed httpx.Client base_url scoping entirely (verified empirically able to reach 169.254.169.254-style metadata hosts). Fix enforces the requested host must match the client's base_url host before the request is sent. This is a security fix, not scope creep -- Mohamed's decision explicitly keeps it.

Now also exports ProviderPool, LLMRouter, ProviderSlot, SlotStatus, FailureCategory from the new sibling module pool.py, to support multi-provider failover exercised by Phase 17 (reports/goed_v1_8_4/failover_integrity_test.json, 8/8 scenarios passed).

Added mock_provider property as alias for is_mock property. Backward compatibility fix: existing script code checks getattr(provider, 'mock_provider', True) to detect real vs mock providers. The property existed only in get_provider_metadata() dict, not as a direct attribute, causing real providers to be misdetected as mock. The is_mock property itself and all provider behavior remain unchanged.

Adds a new get_provider_status() function (line 78) exposing runtime provider/pool health for the failover feature above. The pre-existing v1.8.3 strict real-API gate function names (get_provider, get_provider_from_env, get_runtime_gate_status) are still present with the same docstring language; a true byte-level behavioral diff of those functions was NOT possible this session -- see limitation note in GOED_V1_8_4_FREEZE_DIFF.md.
